idea-plugin.name: Git Commit Message Helper
idea-plugin.description:
A smart Git commit message helper with AI enhancement that assists developers in writing standardized commit messages.

Features:

  • AI-Enhanced Generation: Integrate with OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, or local Ollama to generate intelligent commit messages
  • Automatic commit message template generation based on file changes
  • Commit message format validation (Conventional Commits support)
  • Smart suggestions based on change analysis and git diff
  • Real-time format checking with helpful error messages
  • Support for custom commit message conventions
  • Fallback mechanism for reliable operation

AI Providers Supported:

  • OpenAI GPT (GPT-4, GPT-3.5)
  • Claude (Anthropic)
  • DeepSeek
  • 智谱 AI (ChatGLM)
  • 阿里通义千问 (Qwen)
  • Azure OpenAI
  • Ollama (Local models)
  • Custom endpoints

Supported Commit Types:

  • feat: New features
  • fix: Bug fixes
  • docs: Documentation updates
  • style: Code style changes
  • refactor: Code refactoring
  • test: Test additions or modifications
  • chore: Build process or auxiliary tool changes
